notes.title: New New Year update | 3.6
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Granny Remake Update 3.6 is Live! 🎉[/h1]

[b]🎆 Happy New Year, everyone! 🎆[/b]  
The team at [i]Granny Remake[/i] wishes you a fantastic new year filled with creepy escapes, fun moments, and plenty of challenges. To kick things off, we’ve prepared a fresh update for you!  

[h2]What’s New in 3.6?[/h2]  
[list]
    [*]🚀 [b]Performance Boost[/b] — the game now runs smoother and faster than ever.  
    [*]🛸 [b]New Escape: UFO[/b] — find a way to escape by hitching a ride to space!  
    [*]🎮 [b]Steam Deck Support[/b] — fully optimized for handheld gaming.  
    [*]❄️ [b]Winter is Back[/b] — switch between winter and autumn modes (winter’s here, just like you asked!).  
    [*]🖼️ [b]Visual Improvements[/b] — better lighting, textures, and overall game atmosphere.  
    [*]🔦 [b]Darkness Mode[/b] — turn off all the lights and see how brave you really are.  
    [*]🎁 [b]Loads of New Items[/b] — discover and use new stuff to help you escape.  
[/list]

We’ve worked hard to make the game look and feel even better. Everything’s sharper, creepier, and more fun to explore!  

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎮 What’s Next?[/h2]  
In update 3.7, we’re bringing [b]AMD FSR support[/b] and another brand-new escape route. 🤫 No spoilers yet, but trust us, it’s going to be epic!  

[hr][/hr]

[b]Thank you[/b] for being an amazing community. Enjoy the update, and let us know what you think! 🎉

notes.title: New autumn update | 3.5
notes.content:
🎉 [b]Granny Remake Update![/b] 🎉

Dear players, we are excited to present the latest update for [i]Granny Remake[/i]. Here's the list of changes:

[list]
[*] Added a new car with a redesigned look.
[*] New floor — attic. You can now explore a new level with secrets and challenges.
[*] Introduced a new puzzle — shooting gallery in the attic.
[*] Added a metal detector puzzle to make it easier to find items.
[*] New escape option through the police. Use the flare gun to call for help.
[*] New item — flare gun.
[*] Added a new puzzle — cuckoo clock.
[*] A phone has been added to the game, allowing you to call the police.
[*] Improved environment: added spiders, cobwebs, and other atmospheric elements.
[*] Introduced color filters to customize the visual style of the game.
[*] Some doors now have a bell attached.
[*] Updated Granny's behavior: the flashlight now makes you more visible.
[*] Added the ability to peek around corners using the Q button.
[*] Introduced a scream volume slider to adjust the intensity of scare sounds.
[*] New death scene by electrocution.
[*] Added new paintings.
[*] Improved lighting in the game.
[*] Fixed known bugs and glitches.
[*] Added new music tracks to enhance the tension.
[*] Gameplay improvements have been made to increase the overall scare factor.
[/list]

The update aims to improve the gameplay experience and add new features.

notes.title: New spring update | 3.4
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Major Update for "Granny Remake"! 🎉[/h1]

[b]Dear players,[/b] we are thrilled to announce a [u]new update[/u] for Granny Remake! Here are the main changes we've implemented:

[olist]
[b]New Electric Puzzle:[/b] You will need to figure out how to switch or disconnect electricity to progress in the game.
[b]More Interactive Objects:[/b] We've added new items that influence gameplay.
[b]Text Hints for Players:[/b] These will help you navigate better and make the right decisions.
[b]Change of Location:[/b] The game now takes place in summer, adding new colors and atmosphere.
[b]Improved Granny Behavior:[/b] Granny now reacts if you open something but won't hear you if you are far away.
[b]New Menu Scene: The main menu has a revamped scene.[/b]
[b]New Stealth Movement:[/b] Press ALT to move quietly — fast, silent, and without noise.
[b]Medkit for Player:[/b] Use the medkit to restore strength and continue the game.
[b]Changed Soda Effect:[/b] Drinking soda now temporarily increases your speed.
[b]Enhanced Granny AI:[/b] Granny has become smarter and more dangerous.
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've resolved known issues to improve your interaction with the game.
[/olist]

Thank you for your support and feedback, which help us make Granny Remake better with each update! [b]Try the new features and improvements, and share your experiences.[/b] Good luck trying to survive and escape from Granny!

notes.title: New winter update | 3.3
notes.content:
[b]🎉 Winter Update for "Granny Remake"! 🎉[/b]

We're excited to present our new winter update, significantly enriching the gaming experience:

[olist]
[b]Optimization and Bug Fixes[/b]: We've worked hard to make the game run smoother, eliminating previous errors and making gameplay more stable and comfortable for players.
[b]New Closet Capture Animation[/b]: Introducing a thrilling new mechanic - now Granny can catch you right in the closet. This not only adds novelty but also increases tension at key moments.
[b]New Item – Tomato[/b]: Discover new tactics with the tomato, which can be used to temporarily distract Granny, giving you precious seconds to plan your next move.
[b]Enhanced Visual Effects[/b]: We've significantly bolstered the visual aspect of the game, including more realistic effects that make immersion even more complete.
[b]New Puzzle[/b]: Diversify your gaming experience with a new puzzle, adding an additional layer of intrigue and challenges to solve.
[b]New Item Spawn Locations[/b]: We've expanded the number of places where items can appear, making exploration of the game world more exciting and unpredictable.
[b]Festive Decorations[/b]: Festive decorations add an atmosphere of celebration and novelty, enlivening the game world in this magical season.
[/olist]
